⭐ CAUSE 1, BY SUBTRACTION: `open_defects()` IS RE-RUN INSIDE EVERY ROLLUP, UNCACHED. `detect_defects` alone is 5.2 s fresh / 5.8 s live. `heal.rs:964 open_defects()` has no memoisation and TEN call sites across six files.
